faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a boat rental in Marbella in 2039?
faq.a: The maximum passenger capacity on our fleet is 12 pax. This applies to models like the Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, and Azimut 58 Flybridge. For larger groups, we can arrange multiple boats or a custom event charter.

faq.q: Are there smaller boats for intimate groups?
faq.a: Yes. The Dubhe (8m) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m) each carry 5 passengers, ideal for couples or small families. The Speedboat (7m) and Bandido (11.5m) accommodate 6–8 pax respectively.

faq.q: Why are group size limits enforced?
faq.a: Limits are set by the boat's safety certificate, insurance policy, and Spanish maritime regulations. Overloading compromises stability and emergency evacuation. We always comply with the law to keep you safe.

faq.q: Can children count towards the passenger limit?
faq.a: Yes, every person on board, including infants and children, counts toward the maximum capacity. Life jackets for all ages are provided as part of our safety equipment.

faq.q: What is the cost for a group of 9–12 people?
faq.a: For 9–12 pax, Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 (24m) start at €4,719 for 4 hours, including a free jet ski. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €2,299 for 8 hours and carry up to 11 pax.

faq.q: What happens if my group exceeds 12 people?
faq.a: We recommend booking two boats simultaneously, departing from Puerto Banús together. Alternatively, contact us via WhatsApp for a custom event charter that may allow larger capacity on a superyacht.

faq.q: Is there a minimum group size?
faq.a: No minimum. Solo travellers and couples are welcome on any boat that suits their capacity. The Dubhe and Mariah SX21 are popular for two-person charters.

faq.q: Do the group size limits apply to all departure points?
faq.a: Yes. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús. The limits are uniform across our fleet, regardless of destination (Marbella coast, Cabopino, or Estepona).

data.body_html:
When planning a Marbella boat rental group size limits 2039 are the first thing to check. Overloading a boat isn't just uncomfortable—it's illegal and dangerous. This guide explains exactly how many passengers each of our vessels can carry, what the rules are, and how to choose the right boat for your party.

Why Group Size Limits Matter

Spanish maritime law, insurance policies, and the boat's safety certificate all dictate a strict maximum passenger number. Exceeding it voids insurance and puts everyone at risk. Our fleet is certified for capacities ranging from 5 to 12 passengers, and we never compromise on safety.

Choosing the Right Boat for Your Group

For small groups of 5 or fewer, the Dubhe or Mariah SX21 are cost-effective and easy to handle. Groups of 6–8 will enjoy the Bandido or Red Tide. For 9–11 passengers, the Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or Azimut 39 offer great value. If you have 12 people, go straight to a Tier B boat like the Mangusta 80, which includes a free jet ski and starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. For larger parties, consider booking two boats from our fleet.

Pricing by Group Size

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are perfect for groups up to 11 and cost €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours, with all inclusions. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80 variants) are for 12 passengers and start at €4,719 for 4 hours. For all other boats, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance—no hidden fees.

What If Your Group Exceeds 12?

If your party is larger than 12, we recommend booking two boats simultaneously from Puerto Banús. Alternatively, contact us for a custom event charter that may accommodate larger numbers on a superyacht. We can coordinate itineraries so both boats meet up at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a shared experience.

Local Regulations for 2039

As of 2039, Spanish maritime regulations remain strict. All charters must comply with Real Decreto 1027/1989 and subsequent updates. Life jackets for every passenger, a licensed skipper, and safety briefing are mandatory. Our boats are inspected annually, and we enforce capacity limits to ensure your day on the Costa del Sol is both fun and safe.

Book with Confidence

Knowing your group size is the first step to a perfect day at sea. Whether you're celebrating a birthday in Puerto Banús or cruising to Estepona, we have the right boat. Browse our full fleet or message us on WhatsApp to check availability for your party size. We'll help you pick the best vessel for your group.

Frequently asked questions

What is the maximum group size for a boat rental in Marbella in 2039?

The maximum passenger capacity on our fleet is 12 pax. This applies to models like the Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, and Azimut 58 Flybridge. For larger groups, we can arrange multiple boats or a custom event charter.

Are there smaller boats for intimate groups?

Yes. The Dubhe (8m) and Mariah SX21 (6.4m) each carry 5 passengers, ideal for couples or small families. The Speedboat (7m) and Bandido (11.5m) accommodate 6–8 pax respectively.

Why are group size limits enforced?

Limits are set by the boat's safety certificate, insurance policy, and Spanish maritime regulations. Overloading compromises stability and emergency evacuation. We always comply with the law to keep you safe.

Can children count towards the passenger limit?

Yes, every person on board, including infants and children, counts toward the maximum capacity. Life jackets for all ages are provided as part of our safety equipment.

What is the cost for a group of 9–12 people?

For 9–12 pax, Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 (24m) start at €4,719 for 4 hours, including a free jet ski. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €2,299 for 8 hours and carry up to 11 pax.

What happens if my group exceeds 12 people?

We recommend booking two boats simultaneously, departing from Puerto Banús together. Alternatively, contact us via WhatsApp for a custom event charter that may allow larger capacity on a superyacht.

Is there a minimum group size?

No minimum. Solo travellers and couples are welcome on any boat that suits their capacity. The Dubhe and Mariah SX21 are popular for two-person charters.

Do the group size limits apply to all departure points?

Yes. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús. The limits are uniform across our fleet, regardless of destination (Marbella coast, Cabopino, or Estepona).
